svg.text: Review only · current production remains stable · broader acoustic mass + connection-aware support ownership
The horizontal is serviceable, but both orientations still
treat each cell like a self-contained product. Repeated
supports and transverse visual events keep the run from
reading as one continuous furniture system.
1. acoustic field dominates at far scale 2. internal body
tiles are post-free 3. one graph vertex owns one support 4.
vertical body is longitudinal, not stacked 5. corner and
broad acoustic furniture; soft molded shoulders; support
stronger machine-family molding; slimmer acoustic band;
